decisions.reason: The Hindi-only preview instruction does not change the required organic call to action.
The preview language and workflow change does not alter the audience age range or Indian target market.
The source does not change which product benefits or source material must inform the advertising message.
Replacing immediate script submission with preview shots does not cancel or modify the required keywords and wording constraints; those remain applicable to the concept.
The candidate already has a complete same-message INTRODUCE recording the 10-second Hindi-only preview, its contents, and its approval purpose.
The preview-first instruction does not change the freelancer's responsibility to supply the footage, voiceover, and script for full production.
The source changes the language and review format, not the requirement to align the creative with the supplied references.
The Hindi-only preview instruction does not modify the required strength, directness, or viral style of the opening hook.
Requiring Hindi dialogue in the preview does not alter the existing lip-sync accuracy standard.
The source explicitly constrains preview dialogue but does not mention subtitles or necessarily change their language or formatting standard.
The language and preview-shot instruction does not resolve or modify the required audio level, mix elements, or existing audio-value ambiguity.
The source does not change the required UGC color grading or final visual finish.
